entry.content:
Markdown syntax guide

Headers

Sed nec arcu sagittis, mollis erat at, gravida ante. Vestibulum quam ipsum, pellentesque a tempor nec, maximus sit amet nisi. Etiam odio lorem, facilisis quis tincidunt non, mollis vel justo. Phasellus metus sem, fringilla eleifend accumsan ac, faucibus nec tortor. Praesent nec elit dolor. Etiam mattis porta volutpat. Nulla justo elit, ullamcorper sit amet elit in, fringilla tempus metus.

This is a heading h1

This is a heading h2

This is a heading h3

Emphasis

This text will be italic This will also be italic

This text will be bold This will also be bold

You can combine them

Lists

Unordered

  • Item 1
  • Item 2
  • Item 2a
  • Item 2b
    • Item 3a
    • Item 3b

Ordered

  1. Item 1
  2. Item 2
  3. Item 3
    1. Item 3a
    2. Item 3b

Images

Links

You may be using JQuery.

Blockquotes

Markdown is a lightweight markup language with plain-text-formatting syntax, created in 2004 by John Gruber with Aaron Swartz.

Markdown is often used to format readme files, for writing messages in online discussion forums, and to create rich text using a plain text editor.

Tables

Left columns Right columns
left foo right foo
left bar right bar
left baz right baz

Blocks of code

let message = 'Hello world';
alert(message);

number = int(input("Enter a number: "))

if number % 2 == 0:
    print("It is even!")
else:
    print("It is odd!")

Inline code
